basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) is hiring Assistant Professors at two levels. Grade-I is a regular post at Level-12 and Grade-II is a contract post at Level-10. The posts are in Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Applied Science & Humanities, and every candidate must hold a Ph.D. Online applications open on 29 October 2026 and close on 28 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The signed hard copy must then reach the Institute by 9 December 2026, 05:30 PM.

application_fee.details: The fee is non-refundable and is charged per department per post. It is paid online through the link on the recruitment portal. IIIT Pune's regular employees pay no fee.

how_to_apply: Go to the E-Samarth recruitment portal (www.iiitp.ac.in) and register.
Read the instructions, check your eligibility, fill in the online form and upload scanned copies of the relevant documents, with conclusive evidence for every claim.
Pay the fee through the portal link.
Note the unique E-Samarth Form No. generated after submission. It identifies you for the written test and interview, and no enquiry about a lost Form No. is entertained.

Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of ____, Level ____ in the Department of ____, E-Samarth Form No. ____".

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Pune
content_sections.text: IIIT Pune describes itself as an "Institute of National Importance". It was set up by an act of Parliament under the Public Private Partnership (PPP) model, under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Institute runs B.Tech, M.Tech and Ph.D. programmes from its permanent campus in the foothills of the Western Ghats at Talegaon (Maval), Dist. Pune, Maharashtra - 410507.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Grade-II (Level-10): This post is purely contractual. The contract runs for one year from joining and is renewed every year on performance, up to a maximum of 5 years. Grade-I (Level-12): One year of probation, then regularisation if probation and the other Institute requirements are met. Probation may be extended. Appointees are covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS 2004) as per Government of India rules. Additional incentives as per Institute norms: Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA), seed money, reimbursement of Children Education Allowance, medical facilities and Leave Travel Concession. Appointments and pay fixation are subject to approval by the Board of Governors.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for Grade-II without any experience?
faq.answer: Yes. Annexure-II lists Nil experience and Nil credit points for Assistant Professor Grade-II. You still need a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and a first class in your preceding degrees.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience is needed for Assistant Professor Grade-I?
faq.answer: You need 03 years after the Ph.D., or 06 years of total teaching and research experience in a reputed academic institute, R&D lab or relevant industry. You also need 20 cumulative credit points.

faq.question: Q3. What counts as first class if my university does not define it?
faq.answer: The notice treats minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA as first class.

faq.question: Q4. Is the Grade-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely contractual. The contract runs one year at a time and is renewed on performance, up to a maximum of 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the written test cut-off?
faq.answer: The cut-off is 35% for SC/ST/PWD candidates and 40% for all other categories. The test is qualifying only, and the final merit depends entirely on the presentation-cum-interview.

faq.question: Q6. Do women candidates pay a lower fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Female candidates pay the same as SC/ST/PwBD candidates: 1000 + GST 18%, which is Rs. 1180/-.

faq.question: Q7. I want to apply in two departments. Is one form enough?
faq.answer: No. You need a separate complete application and fee for each post or department. A single form covering more than one department is summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO – Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra – 410507. It must arrive by 9 December 2026, 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q9. I did my Ph.D. at IIIT Pune. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Only if you have 3 years of experience outside IIIT Pune after your Ph.D. This is the notice's in-breeding restriction.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel expenses be paid for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for the written test, the presentation-cum-interview or any other stage at the Talegaon campus.
